description.value: York St. Diner is a locally owned family restaurant that has been a Cowichan Valley staple since 2012, known for scratch-made eggs Benedict, chicken and waffles, and a rotating menu of daily features. It is fully licensed and sources ingredients from local Cowichan Valley suppliers. Touring cyclists will find a welcoming diner atmosphere with full breakfast, brunch, lunch, and dinner service.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content was successfully fetched and is the primary evidence source. The contact page confirms the address (5849 York Rd, Duncan, BC V9L 3S2) and phone ((250) 597-0400), neither of which appear in the OSM record. The menu page explicitly states 'Gluten Free Options & Egg Whites Available' and lists a Veggie Skillet, confirming GF and vegetarian options. The homepage and contact page both advertise takeout orders. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging, or water refill appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record is missing address and phone; both were sourced from the website contact page and should be added to OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible diner with an active website and clear business information. A useful stop for touring cyclists in Duncan.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu states 'Gluten Free Options & Egg Whites Available – Just ask your Server'; Veggie Skillet listed on menu; blog post titled 'Gluten-Free and Classic Breakfast Options at York Diner'
